summary: PB-001 PropBenefits Engine Foundation — full stack testing. Backend: 24/24 pytest passing (user endpoints, claim/use flow, admin CRUD+validation+config+tick+impact+growth-advisor cached, security 401/403, mentor pb_ action, referral gating: pending -> paid -> activated with ledger for both parties). Frontend client desktop: pb-hub with pb-membership/pb-next-action/pb-wallet/pb-locked, v2-desktop-nav-benefits, deep-link /client?tab=benefits works. Frontend admin: /admin/prop-benefits pbadmin-page + KPIs + all 5 tabs (Campanii, Niveluri & Config, Subscription Health, AI Growth Advisor, Ecosystem Health) + pbadmin-camp-pbcamp_hh_check + pbadmin-new-campaign + pbadmin-run-tick all rendered. Discovery Center dc-tab-impact + dc-impact panel show PropBenefits Engine in modules list with realized/potential/gap. Mobile: v2-set-benefits opens pb-hub, bottom nav intact (5 items visible).

minor.issue: PropBenefits-driven action loses the 'pb_' id prefix in the final response. Mentor sets id=f'pb_{a[id]}' at ai_brain/mentor.py:43, but the decision layer (ai_brain/decision.next_best_decisions) reassigns action ids to raw decision ids (12-char hex). Result: mentor.actions[].id no longer starts with 'pb_' even for PropBenefits-driven actions. Title still identifies it (contains 'beneficiul...'). Review spec expected id starting with 'pb_'. Test asserts via title fallback and passes, but this is a behavioural drift — decisions pipeline strips PropBenefits provenance.

action_items: Optional: restore 'pb_' id prefix on PropBenefits-driven mentor actions by preserving provenance when actions flow through ai_brain.decision.next_best_decisions (or tag decisions with source='pb' and re-prefix). Non-blocking — behavior is functionally correct (correct action shown, correct CTA), only the id namespace was lost.
critical_code_review_comments: propbenefits/referral_ext.py _user_activated relies on payment_transactions.payment_status=='paid' — undocumented field name; downstream code paths inserting into this collection must use payment_status not status, otherwise referral activation tick will silently no-op.

routes/prop_benefits.py claim_benefit uses result.get('code', 400) but campaigns.claim must return {'code': 409} for duplicates. Verified via test — duplicate claim returns 409, community campaign returns 409, nonexistent 404. Good.
Mentor pb_ prefix regression noted above (decision layer overwrites).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all data-testids found, all tabs render, mobile+desktop deep-links work)

seed_data_creation: None persistent — test class created TEST_pb_* campaign, TEST_pb_ref invitee user + payment_transactions + pb_referral_pending + pb_ledger, all cleaned up in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_pb001_prop_benefits.py — run with `pytest backend/tests/test_pb001_prop_benefits.py -v`. Client demo has active subscription so pbcamp_hh_check is claimable (test claims it on first run; subsequent runs assert 409 duplicate — idempotent by design). Growth advisor tested WITHOUT refresh=true to avoid 30-60s LLM call. If you need to re-test claim UI, delete the client's ledger entry for pbcamp_hh_check first (db.pb_ledger.delete_many({campaign_id:'pbcamp_hh_check', user_id:<client_id>})).
rca of the issue: Mentor pb_ prefix drift: ai_brain/mentor.py builds actions via _actions_client where PropBenefits action id is 'pb_<hex12>'. Then at lines 178-189, if next_best_decisions returns any decisions, `actions` is REPLACED with a list built from decisions using d['id'] directly (raw hex, no pb_ prefix). Fix: in ai_brain/decision.next_best_decisions, preserve or re-inject the original action id (or attach source tag) so mentor can output pb_ prefix. Alternatively, when replacing actions, look up the original action by title match and keep its id. Non-blocking for MVP because CTA path (/client?tab=benefits) and title still communicate PropBenefits origin.
